recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-23916; future preference-guidance work should be handled against the Extension Pack or rank-extension issues.
issue_request: FHIR-23916 was a Published FHIR-core/MnM change request resolved Not Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked for a preference indicator on Address and ContactPoint; the accepted resolution was to use the existing iso21090-preferred extension and restrict its context to Address and ContactPoint instead of all elements/data types.
initial_application: Core history shows the issue was applied before this reconciliation: commit c4807a5165 changed source/profiles/iso-21090-spreadsheet.xml so the preferred extension context moved from Any to Address;ContactPoint. FHIR-23069 separately records the same broad-context problem as a build-tool/context bug that was pre-applied.
additional_context: FHIR-35835 later published a compatible expansion of the same extension context to ExtendedContactDetail, and commit b759378e9a applied it. Commit dd468d4f17 then removed the extension rows from R5 core source; current core keeps only the iso21090-preferred OID, while the Extension Pack StructureDefinition lists Address, ContactPoint, and version-gated ExtendedContactDetail. FHIR-41565 later deprecated/retired iso21090-preferred in favor of rank without changing the historical context decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change is needed because the current authoritative Extension Pack source already carries the correct context restriction as later refined, and changing core would duplicate or reintroduce an extension definition that no longer belongs in the core checkout.
